arms: standalone Claude with ordinary read-only tools
protocol.arm_order: randomized within pair, using a recorded fixed seed
protocol.model: pin exact model identifier and Claude Code version before any paid run; currently unselected
protocol.evidence: Both arms receive identical complete raw workload evidence, including managedFields, object metadata, status, relevant events, controller configuration and source identity. No treatment-only evidence.
protocol.correctness: Binary verified success: every mandatory positive-weight non-tool_used grader is present exactly once and passed=true; any missing/malformed correctness metadata is unknown; any run error is unverified. tool_used indicators do not affect answer success.
protocol.cost: Count actual spend for every arm and retry, including errors, mocks, judge calls and orchestration where attributable. Record provider/API dollars, harness estimates, account credits and tokens separately. If actual credits cannot be attributed, mark them not measured; do not infer from balances. Zero verified answers means cost per verified answer is undefined/infinite.
protocol.attempts: Start with 3 paired repeats for diagnosis; retain each raw result and retry with linked attempt ID. Count interrupted attempts as failures and include all attempt costs in estimates; partial campaigns cannot support complete-suite headlines. Ten repeats per arm are the release-evidence starting point, not a significance guarantee.

cost_envelopes.planning_rate_note: Historical planning arithmetic, not a current quote or guaranteed bill; pin and date actual model pricing before paid execution.

gates.quality: No lower observed verified-success rate; paired 95% interval must not extend below -2 percentage points.
gates.dollars: At least 20% lower task-balanced cost per verified answer, with paired task-level bootstrap interval excluding no saving.
gates.credits: At least 20% lower attributable account-credit cost or explicitly report credits not measured and publish token/list-price evidence.
gates.time: Target 20% lower median; report p95 and investigate regressions above 10%.
gates.mechanism: Measure calls, bytes, duplicate reads, reasoning turns, and plugin/schema overhead.

required_before_execution: all 24 prompts and deterministic references frozen
all cases have mandatory negative controls
pinned model/version and dated pricing recorded
actual-cost/credit accounting route identified or limitations marked
runner authentication and provider limits preflighted
actual ordinary-tool parity and MCP operator grants verified; surrounding-answer claims covered by the declared grading protocol
execution.no_paid_command: Do not execute a paid command until the case set is complete and these gates are approved.
